test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

Even the rules for spelling can cause you to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** "make a mistake".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Make a mistake"** is the correct phrase to use when referring to errors in spelling or grammar.
 
• The verb** "make"** is commonly used with the noun** "mistake"** to indicate that someone has committed an error.
 
 
• **Example**:* "I **made a mistake**__ on my homework." *
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Even the rules for spelling can cause you to __**make a mistake**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"do a mistake"**, is not grammatically correct and should be replaced with **"make a mistake."**
 
• Option 2, **"happen a mistake"**, does not accurately convey the idea of someone intentionally committing an error.
 
• Option 3, **"have a mistake"**, is not the commonly used phrase and may lead to confusion in communication.
